title: Monthly expenses
subtitle: Record what you paid and see where each month went.
updateFailed: The expense could not be updated.
createCategoryDescription: Every expense belongs to a category, such as Rent or Netflix.
emptyDescription: Add what you paid for this month and it will show up here with the total.
deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} expense of {amount}? This cannot be undone.
deleteLinked: {count, plural, one {# linked expense} other {# linked expenses}} will become independent and count on their own in the month total.
deleteFailed: The expense could not be deleted.
savedPending: Saved as pending: it counts toward the month but is not marked as paid yet.
periodHint: The month this expense belongs to, even if you paid it later.
paidWithNone: None, it stands on its own
hintHasChildren: Other expenses were paid with this one, so it cannot be paid with another.
hintOtherMonth: Only expenses from the month you are viewing can be selected.
hintNoCandidates: There are no other expenses in this month yet.
hintLinked: Included in {name}'s amount, so it is not added again to the month total.
hintStandalone: Leave empty if it was paid on its own.

copy.title: Copy from {month}
copy.none: There are no expenses in the previous month to copy.
copy.intro: Pick the ones to add to this month. They are added as pending, so you can mark them as paid later. An expense paid with another one stays linked only if you pick both.

balance.title: Income vs spending
balance.noIncome: No income recorded for {month}, so there is nothing to compare your spending with.
balance.over: Over budget by {amount}: you plan to spend more than you earned in {month}.
balance.tight: Tight: {percent}% of your income is already spoken for.
balance.ok: {percent}% of your income is spent or pending.
